loss: cross-entropy + mean soft Dice over disc (rim ∪ cup), rim and cup
augmentations: rotation ±10°, scale 0.9–1.1, translation ±5% (image bilinear, mask nearest, black fill)
brightness x0.7-1.3 and contrast x0.7-1.3 (image only, foreground mean)
independent RGB gains x0.65-1.35 and gamma 0.7-1.5 (image only)
retain black pixels <=1/255 after spatial transforms; targets unchanged by photometry
selection_rule: highest validation mean of per-image (disc Dice + cup Dice)/2 at model resolution, post-processed predictions vs expert 1
